dedupe_keys.name: dataset on weather related natural disasters in agriculture in italy 2005 2021 crea observatory for agricultural meteorology

description: Officially declared weather-related natural disasters affecting agriculture in Italy from 2005 to 2021, extracted from the relational database of the Observatory for agricultural meteorology and climatology of CREA's Research Center for Agriculture and Environment. The Zenodo record says the Observatory website has a section on weather-related risk in agriculture, and that the dataset is meant for risk assessment and analysis in the Italian agricultural sector. Version v1.0 was published on 18 September 2024 by Antonella Pontrandolfi and Antonio Gerardo Pepe (CREA), with a CSV of about 90 KB and a PDF description of about 180 KB, free under CC BY 4.0; keywords include weather extremes, agrometeorology and impacts of climate change on agriculture. Coverage is Italy. Caveats: only disasters officially declared under national compensation rules are included, so events without a declaration are missing, and fields must be read from the PDF. For simulation it gives an event list of droughts, frosts, hail, floods and storms that hit farming, by date and area, to calibrate agricultural damage and recovery models under climate change. Related catalogue records include the USDA RMA cause of loss data and the China agricultural disasters dataset.
